h:
尝试艾拉通过各种提示依从性测试，我创建了此工作流程，以便通过 ELLA/SD15/组合（ELLA 和 SD15 之间的组合条件）/SDXL 进行比较的单个控制输入。

示例中使用的提示：“一只穿着蓝色西装、红色帽子和绿色领带的灰色猫的特写镜头坐在房间里的白色桌子上，房间里有大窗户，可以看到被鲜花覆盖的沙漠景观”

更多信息：https://github.com/diffustar/comfyui-workflow-collection/tree/master/workflows/ella

欢迎加入不和谐如有更多问题或讨论

o.en:
Experimenting withELLAwith various prompt adherence tests I created this workflow to have a single control input to compare through ELLA/SD15/Combined (Conditioning combined between ELLA and SD15)/SDXL.

Used prompt in the example: "closeup of a grey cat wearing a blue suit, a red hat and a green tie is sitting on a white table in a room with big windows viewing over a desert landscape covered by flowers"

More info onhttps://github.com/diffustar/comfyui-workflow-collection/tree/master/workflows/ella

Feel free to join thediscordfor more questions or discussion
